prompt.zh:
用途：陶瓷随行杯主图。目标画幅：4:5。
一只青绿色陶瓷随行杯放在暖灰石灰岩台面，杯盖为哑光奶油白；右侧有一片柔和的弧形阴影，左上方自然窗光，保留细微釉面颗粒，产品占画面高度65%，上方留出20%文案区。
文字要求：无文字。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Ceramic travel mug hero. Target aspect ratio: 4:5.
One teal ceramic travel mug with a matte cream lid on warm gray limestone. Natural upper-left window light, a gentle curved shadow to the right, visible glaze grain. Product occupies 65% of image height; reserve the top 20% for copy.
Text requirement: No text. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 检查杯口椭圆、盖子接缝和接触阴影。
quality_check.en: Check the rim ellipse, lid seam and contact shadow.

prompt.zh:
用途：护肤套装俯拍。目标画幅：1:1。
三件虚构品牌护肤容器：磨砂玻璃滴管瓶、白色软管、矮圆罐；在淡杏色纸面上形成疏松三角形，右上角一滴透明凝胶，每个容器之间至少留出一个瓶盖宽的距离。
文字要求：仅瓶身标签：NOMA。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Skincare kit flat lay. Target aspect ratio: 1:1.
Three fictional skincare containers: a frosted dropper bottle, white tube and low round jar. Arrange a loose triangle on apricot paper, with one clear gel drop at upper right and at least one cap-width of space between containers.
Text requirement: Only container labels: NOMA. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 三个容器不能融合，标签应贴合曲面。
quality_check.en: Keep containers separate and labels wrapped to their surfaces.

prompt.zh:
用途：背包功能细节。目标画幅：3:2。
橄榄绿城市背包放在木凳上，侧袋插入金属水壶；画面右侧设置两个独立放大窗口，分别展示拉链齿和肩带编织纹理，用细线指向实际部位。
文字要求：无文字。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Backpack detail campaign. Target aspect ratio: 3:2.
An olive urban backpack on a wooden stool with a metal bottle in its side pocket. Two separate detail insets on the right show zipper teeth and woven shoulder-strap texture, connected by thin leaders to their actual locations.
Text requirement: No text. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 放大窗口必须对应原物，不能虚构额外口袋。
quality_check.en: Insets must match the bag; do not invent extra pockets.

prompt.zh:
用途：银饰微距。目标画幅：1:1。
一枚不规则锤纹银戒指竖立于深蓝棉纸上，单一窄条柔光形成连续高光，浅景深但戒指外轮廓完整清晰；避免高光溢出导致金属变成白色塑料。
文字要求：无文字。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Silver ring macro. Target aspect ratio: 1:1.
A hammered silver ring upright on deep blue cotton paper. One narrow softbox creates a continuous highlight; shallow depth of field with the entire outer contour readable. Preserve metallic tonal transitions without clipping to white plastic.
Text requirement: No text. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 戒圈应闭合，内外反射方向一致。
quality_check.en: Check the closed band and consistent internal reflections.

prompt.zh:
用途：咖啡新品海报。目标画幅：4:5。
一杯冰橙咖啡在珊瑚橙背景前，透明玻璃杯凝有细小水珠，橙皮卷形成引导线，冰块数量适中；上方大标题，下方单行副标题，不添加价格或促销承诺。
文字要求：标题：ORANGE HOUR；副标题：A brighter coffee break。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Coffee launch poster. Target aspect ratio: 4:5.
An iced orange coffee in a clear glass with fine condensation against coral orange. A curled orange peel leads the eye; a few distinct ice cubes. Large headline above, a single subtitle below; no prices or promotional claims.
Text requirement: Headline: ORANGE HOUR; subtitle: A brighter coffee break. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 检查字母拼写、冰块透视和杯底阴影。
quality_check.en: Check spelling, ice perspective and glass contact shadow.

prompt.zh:
用途：跑步社群招募。目标画幅：9:16。
清晨河畔，三位不同体型的成年跑者以轻松配速向右跑，反光背心有合理织物细节；下半部留出干净雾蓝渐变，排版像独立社区活动宣传。
文字要求：RUN TOGETHER；SATURDAY 07:00。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Running club recruitment. Target aspect ratio: 9:16.
Three adult runners of different builds jogging rightward along a river at dawn, with plausible reflective fabric details. Reserve the lower portion as a clean mist-blue gradient for independent community event typography.
Text requirement: RUN TOGETHER; SATURDAY 07:00. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 三位人物肢体分离，时间只出现一次。
quality_check.en: Separate all limbs and render the time once.

prompt.zh:
用途：茶叶包装概念。目标画幅：3:2。
虚构乌龙茶品牌的纸盒、茶罐和封口贴，米白与墨绿双色，抽象山脊压纹；三件包装置于同一桌面，用平视三分之四视角展示，包装不冒充已上市产品。
文字要求：RIDGE TEA；OOLONG。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Tea packaging concept. Target aspect ratio: 3:2.
A fictional oolong tea box, tin and seal sticker in ivory and forest green, with abstract embossed ridgelines. All three sit on one tabletop in a three-quarter view; present a packaging concept, not an existing product.
Text requirement: RIDGE TEA; OOLONG. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 检查品牌名统一、盒子透视和罐盖结构。
quality_check.en: Check consistent naming, box perspective and tin lid construction.

prompt.zh:
用途：独立书店开业。目标画幅：4:5。
奶油色底上的编辑式书店海报，中心为一扇暖黄灯光的蓝色小门，两侧堆叠不同高度的书；保留纸张纹理，标题采用深蓝粗体，装饰元素少于五个。
文字要求：TURN A PAGE；OPENING WEEKEND。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Independent bookshop opening. Target aspect ratio: 4:5.
An editorial bookshop poster on cream paper. A small blue doorway with warm yellow light sits between uneven stacks of books. Visible paper grain, bold navy headline and fewer than five decorative elements.
Text requirement: TURN A PAGE; OPENING WEEKEND. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 标题可读，书脊不要生成伪作者名字。
quality_check.en: Keep headlines readable; omit invented author names on spines.

prompt.zh:
用途：桌面整理轮播。目标画幅：4:5。
俯拍真实居家工作桌，左侧只有键盘、笔记本和一杯水，右侧放三个整齐收纳盒，采用燕麦色与鼠尾草绿，标题位于顶部空白纸片上。
文字要求：RESET YOUR DESK。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Desk reset carousel cover. Target aspect ratio: 4:5.
Top-down view of a believable home desk. Keyboard, notebook and water glass on the left; three tidy storage boxes on the right. Oat and sage palette, headline on a blank paper area at top.
Text requirement: RESET YOUR DESK. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 避免把收纳视觉包装成真实效果对比。
quality_check.en: Present an organizing concept rather than fabricated measured results.

prompt.zh:
用途：摄影灯光视频缩略图。目标画幅：16:9。
同一位虚构成年摄影师在同一构图内左右对照，左半为平淡顶光，右半为柔和侧光；两侧面部、服饰和表情相同，中间用细竖线分割，背景为深灰摄影棚。
文字要求：ONE LIGHT。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Lighting tutorial thumbnail. Target aspect ratio: 16:9.
The same fictional adult photographer in a split comparison: flat overhead light on the left, soft side light on the right. Match face, clothing, expression and framing across both halves. Thin vertical divider, dark gray studio background.
Text requirement: ONE LIGHT. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 只改变光线，不能把不同人物当成前后对比。
quality_check.en: Change lighting only; both halves must depict the same person.

prompt.zh:
用途：早餐食谱卡。目标画幅：4:5。
编辑式早餐卡片，上半为酸奶燕麦碗的顶视摄影，下半为三条短步骤，碗里有蓝莓、香蕉片和南瓜籽；勺子放在右侧，不遮挡文字。
文字要求：MORNING BOWL；1. Add yogurt；2. Layer oats；3. Top with fruit。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Breakfast recipe card. Target aspect ratio: 4:5.
An editorial breakfast card: overhead yogurt-oat bowl photo above, three short steps below. Blueberries, banana slices and pumpkin seeds in the bowl; spoon at right, clear of type.
Text requirement: MORNING BOWL; 1. Add yogurt; 2. Layer oats; 3. Top with fruit. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 顺序准确，不能添加营养或减重承诺。
quality_check.en: Keep steps ordered and omit nutrition or weight-loss promises.

prompt.zh:
用途：播客封面。目标画幅：1:1。
抽象奶油色圆形声波围绕一颗赤陶色球体，在深紫背景上营造安静夜谈气氛；采用两级排版，缩小至手机封面仍能辨认标题。
文字要求：AFTER HOURS；Small conversations, wider ideas。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Podcast cover. Target aspect ratio: 1:1.
Abstract cream circular sound waves surround a terracotta sphere on a deep violet background, evoking a quiet evening conversation. Use two typography levels; the title should remain legible at phone-cover size.
Text requirement: AFTER HOURS; Small conversations, wider ideas. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 检查缩略图辨识度，文字不要绕球弯曲。
quality_check.en: Check thumbnail readability and keep lettering unwarped.

prompt.zh:
用途：植物生长课堂图。目标画幅：3:2。
儿童课堂用的四阶段植物生长图，从左到右为种子、萌芽、幼苗和开花；每个阶段独立置于相同大小的圆角框内，土壤线对齐，用单向箭头串联，白底柔和配色。
文字要求：Seed；Sprout；Seedling；Flower。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Plant growth classroom diagram. Target aspect ratio: 3:2.
A four-stage classroom diagram from left to right: seed, sprout, seedling and flowering plant. Equal rounded panels, aligned soil levels, one-way connecting arrows, white background and gentle colors.
Text requirement: Seed; Sprout; Seedling; Flower. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 顺序与标签一一对应，不把根画在土壤上方。
quality_check.en: Match labels to stages and place roots below soil.

prompt.zh:
用途：简化水循环。目标画幅：16:9。
面向小学的简化水循环剖面图，左侧海洋、右侧山地，中间云团；只画三条清晰箭头：海面向上、云向山地下雨、河流回海，图形平面化，背景干净。
文字要求：Evaporation；Precipitation；Collection。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Simple water cycle. Target aspect ratio: 16:9.
A simplified primary-school water-cycle cutaway: ocean left, mountain right and clouds between. Exactly three clear arrows: up from ocean, rain from cloud to land, river back to ocean. Flat shapes, uncluttered background.
Text requirement: Evaporation; Precipitation; Collection. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 这是简化教学图；校对箭头，避免逆向河流。
quality_check.en: Treat as a simplified teaching aid; verify arrows and river direction.

prompt.zh:
用途：手冲咖啡步骤图。目标画幅：4:5。
纵向四步手冲咖啡示意，每步一张独立小插图：放滤纸、加入咖啡粉、缓慢注水、移走滤杯；米白底和棕色线条，步骤之间留足空间。
文字要求：1 FILTER；2 GROUNDS；3 POUR；4 SERVE。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Pour-over process diagram. Target aspect ratio: 4:5.
Vertical four-step pour-over diagram with separate illustrations: place filter, add grounds, pour slowly, remove dripper. Cream background, brown linework and generous space between steps.
Text requirement: 1 FILTER; 2 GROUNDS; 3 POUR; 4 SERVE. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 滤杯、壶和杯子的结构在四步中一致。
quality_check.en: Keep dripper, kettle and cup designs consistent.

prompt.zh:
用途：文件整理决策树。目标画幅：16:9。
只包含五个节点的流程图：顶部问题节点，左侧保留节点与归档节点，右侧删除候选节点与人工复核节点；深蓝线条、白色卡片、浅灰底，连接线不得交叉。
文字要求：NEEDED?；KEEP；ARCHIVE；DELETE CANDIDATE；REVIEW。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: File organization decision tree. Target aspect ratio: 16:9.
A five-node file-organizing flowchart: question node at top; KEEP and ARCHIVE nodes on the left; DELETE CANDIDATE and REVIEW nodes on the right. Navy connectors, white cards, pale gray background, no crossing lines.
Text requirement: NEEDED?; KEEP; ARCHIVE; DELETE CANDIDATE; REVIEW. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 从NEEDED?连接KEEP与DELETE CANDIDATE，KEEP连接ARCHIVE，DELETE CANDIDATE连接REVIEW；不暗示自动删除。
quality_check.en: Connect NEEDED? to KEEP and DELETE CANDIDATE; KEEP to ARCHIVE; DELETE CANDIDATE to REVIEW. Do not imply automatic deletion.

prompt.zh:
用途：自然职业头像。目标画幅：1:1。
一位虚构成年建筑设计师的肩部以上头像，棕色棉衬衫、温和自然表情，背景为虚化浅灰墙，眼睛清晰，保留肤质和自然不对称，柔和窗光。
文字要求：无文字。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Natural professional avatar. Target aspect ratio: 1:1.
Head-and-shoulders portrait of a fictional adult architect wearing a brown cotton shirt with a relaxed expression. Defocused light gray wall, sharp eyes, natural skin texture and asymmetry, soft window light.
Text requirement: No text. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 不磨皮成塑料，不添加证件或公司标志。
quality_check.en: Avoid plastic skin, credentials and company logos.

prompt.zh:
用途：雨夜环境人像。目标画幅：2:3。
成年骑行者站在雨后路边咖啡馆屋檐下，芥末黄色雨衣、湿润自行车车把，远处琥珀色灯光虚化；人物面部接受柔和环境光，不做夸张霓虹。
文字要求：无文字。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Rainy evening portrait. Target aspect ratio: 2:3.
An adult cyclist under a roadside café awning after rain, mustard raincoat and wet bicycle handlebars. Distant amber bokeh, softly lit face, restrained colors without exaggerated neon.
Text requirement: No text. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 手指自然握把，雨衣和地面湿润程度一致。
quality_check.en: Check fingers on handlebars and consistent surface wetness.

prompt.zh:
用途：手艺人品牌肖像。目标画幅：4:5。
一位虚构成年陶艺师在工作室修整半干陶碗，手和工具清楚，人物偏左，右侧留自然暗部作采访引文区域，木架上只有少量陶器。
文字要求：无文字。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:
Use case: Artisan brand portrait. Target aspect ratio: 4:5.
A fictional adult potter trimming a leather-hard bowl in a studio. Clearly visible hands and tool, person left of center, natural dark area at right for a later interview quote, only a few pots on wooden shelves.
Text requirement: No text. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 工具接触陶碗的位置合理，保留手部泥痕。
quality_check.en: Check tool contact and retain clay marks on hands.

prompt.zh:
用途：小团队合照。目标画幅：16:9。
四位虚构成年创作者围坐明亮共享工作室，桌上放纸质草图和两台合上的电脑；坐姿自然且互不遮挡，每个人服饰颜色不同，像真实编辑采访照片。
文字要求：无文字。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。
构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。
prompt.en:

文字要求：保留原图文字，不新增文字。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。

Text requirement: Preserve existing lettering; add none. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

Text requirement: Replace Create together with Crea en equipo; replace Join now with Únete ahora. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 校对重音字符和其他文字；不能改动日期或价格。

Text requirement: Preserve existing lettering; add none. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 局部放大检查领口边缘、发丝和手部是否被误改。
quality_check.en: Inspect collar edges, hair and hands for unintended edits.

文字要求：保留图1产品文字，不新增文字。除指定文字外不添加任何文字、水印或签名。

Use case: Three-reference product composite. Target aspect ratio: 16:9.
Image 1 defines the owned product identity; image 2 provides layout only; image 3 provides palette only. Place the product at the center of image 2’s table with image 3’s warm gray and teal lighting. Do not import brands or objects from images 2 or 3.
Text requirement: Keep product lettering from image 1; add none. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 分别核对身份、布局和色调；一次只纠正一个偏差。
quality_check.en: Verify identity, layout and palette separately; correct one drift at a time.

构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。

Text requirement: MAKE ROOM FOR IDEAS. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 标题准确，不虚构作者、奖项或畅销标识。
quality_check.en: Check title and omit invented authors, awards or bestseller seals.

构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。

Use case: Ultrawide website banner. Target aspect ratio: 4:1.
Ultrawide still-life banner. Teal ceramic cup and rolled ivory paper in the left quarter, clean warm gray negative space across the central half, small yellow abstract sculpture in the right quarter. Continuous left-to-right light.
Text requirement: No text. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

虚构海边小城旅行小志跨页，左页一张港口照片，右页为两张细节照片：旧蓝门和一碗柑橘；宽页边距、细黑线、少量标题，中央装订线清晰。

构图保持清晰层级、合理留白和统一光源。不要添加未要求的物件。输出单张完成图。

Fictional coastal-town travel zine spread: harbor photo on left page, old blue doorway and bowl of citrus in two detail photos on right. Wide margins, fine black rules, minimal headline and visible center gutter.
Text requirement: A SLOWER COAST. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.

quality_check.zh: 不要生成虚假地名、地址或旅游事实。
quality_check.en: Do not invent place names, addresses or travel facts.

Text requirement: No text. No other lettering, watermark or signature.
Maintain clear visual hierarchy, useful negative space and consistent light direction. Do not add unrequested objects. Deliver one finished image.
